paper.title: Responsible Task Automation: Empowering Large Language Models as Responsible Task Automators
paper.central_claim: ResponsibleTA 以可行性预测、完整性验证与安全保护三项能力使 LLM 协调器与执行器负责任地协作;在 UI 任务自动化上提高成功率、减少无效执行并保护隐私(作者原主张)

evidence.quote: we present Responsible Task Automation (ResponsibleTA) as a fundamental framework to facilitate responsible collaboration between LLM-based coordinators and executors for task automation with three empowered capabilities: 1) predicting the feasibility of the commands for executors; 2) verifying the completeness of executors; 3) enhancing the security (e.g., the protection of users’ privacy).
evidence.support_explanation: 中心主张

evidence.quote: Existing works [ 36 , 39 , 30 , 18 ] just tell LLMs the powers of executors with model/API descriptions via heavy prompt engineering.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者 gap:现有只靠提示描述执行器能力

evidence.quote: However, these descriptions are commonly manually written and summary-like, which are inadequate to describe the executors’ capabilities and cannot reflect the execution completeness for LLMs.
evidence.support_explanation: gap 论点(断言,无实验证据)

evidence.quote: In addition, LLMs are also possible to have insufficient awareness of the task goals and environments, thus issuing unreasonable instructions to executors.
evidence.support_explanation: gap:LLM 发出不合理指令

evidence.quote: Previous work [ 1 ] attempts to address the executability issue by training an external model to critic the outputs of LLM.
evidence.support_explanation: 最近邻:外部 critic(SayCan 类)

evidence.quote: To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to systematically study the reliability of LLM-based task automation from feasibility, completeness and security perspectives.
evidence.support_explanation: 新颖性主张(未做系统检索)

evidence.quote: Before each execution, the feasibility predictor assesses whether the generated low-level command is executable in practice upon the current screenshot and this command itself.
evidence.support_explanation: 可行性预测器输入:当前截图+命令

evidence.quote: After each execution, the completeness verifier checks whether the execution result aligns with the goal of given low-level command. Replanning will be launched by LLM once an invalid or unfulfilled execution is detected.
evidence.support_explanation: 完整性验证器+重规划

evidence.quote: The completeness verifier in ResponsibleTA takes the executed command and the screenshot after execution as its inputs to assess the completeness of this command.
evidence.support_explanation: 验证器只看命令+执行后截图(无执行前状态)

evidence.quote: When reaching the pre-set maximum number of replanning attempts, the LLM will terminate the current task and offer feedbacks for users.
evidence.support_explanation: 重规划上限(数值未给)

evidence.quote: we input the UI element information on the screen to the LLM in linguistic form through a trained screen parsing model only when replanning is needed
evidence.support_explanation: 协调器仅在重规划时获得屏幕元素信息 → 与基线的信息差

evidence.quote: the security protector uses a NER model ( e . g ., Bert-NER [ 19 ] ) to automatically detect the sensitive information in users’ instructions, and replace them with a information placeholder
evidence.support_explanation: 安全保护:NER+占位符+本地记忆

evidence.quote: We sample about 40K web pages from this open repository, yielding 1.1M image-text pairs. Among them, 1M pairs are used for training while the remaining 100K pairs are for testing.
evidence.support_explanation: 可行性数据:随机划分

evidence.quote: Infeasible commands are generated based on fake element captions that do not appear in the current web page.
evidence.support_explanation: 负例=伪造标题,分布合成

evidence.quote: We generate negative examples by substituting the 3-tuple with fake items.
evidence.support_explanation: 完整性负例=替换为假项
分类指标:Acc/AP/F1,可行性与完整性

evidence.quote: we randomly sample 5K image-text pairs from the test splits on feasibility prediction and completeness verification for evaluating the prompt engineering based paradigms
evidence.support_explanation: LLM 仅在 5K 子样本评测

evidence.quote: the advantage of prompt engineering based paradigms is that they do not require the collection of specific data for training
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认 LLM 范式优势

evidence.quote: via real-world case study on 12 tasks, considering that there are no fledged benchmarks in this research field yet
evidence.support_explanation: 12 个任务的案例研究

evidence.quote: Baseline does not reach the final success on 9 out of 12 tasks. For these 9 tasks, 5 of them are successfully remedied by the feasibility predictor on its own. On top of it, the completeness verifier help turn 2 of them to the final success in addition.
evidence.support_explanation: Baseline 3/12 → +Fea 8/12 → +Com 10/12

evidence.quote: 11 Create a meeting at 2023/04/15 14:00-14:30 in Outlook. 3/6 (8) ✗ 3/3 (8) ✗ 3/3 (8) ✗ 12 Search the Cpython repo and download its zip file in github.com. 5/7 (8) ✗ 6/6 (8) ✗ 6/6 (8) ✗

evidence.quote: valid steps / total execution steps (human expert steps)
evidence.support_explanation: Progress 定义:有效步/总执行步(人类专家步数)

evidence.quote: our proposed ResponsibleTA can effectively reduce the number of invalid instruction executions thanks to its feasibility predictor
evidence.support_explanation: ‘减少无效执行’主张

evidence.quote: We experimentally find that launching the security protector neither affects the task success rate nor increases the number of invalid executions on these two cases for all three models.
evidence.support_explanation: 安全仅 2 个案例,无泄露度量

evidence.quote: The security predictor is installed in all models.
evidence.support_explanation: 安全保护在所有配置中开启

evidence.quote: Its remaining limitations lie in two aspects: 1) benchmark construction; 2) specific model design/iteration aimed at pursuing high performance for this new domain.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认:缺基准、模型迭代

evidence.quote: This task is ultimately terminated when the preset maximum number of replanning attempts is reached.
evidence.support_explanation: 失败案例:重规划耗尽

evidence.quote: It achieves 0.51 mIoU for locating the target UI elements in given commands.
evidence.support_explanation: 执行器本身 mIoU 0.51

evidence.quote: It achieves 0.710 mAP on the test set introduced as follows.

evidence.quote: we perform the finetuning on each task for 20 epochs using 8 NVIDIA V100 GPUs

读图:LLM 协调器→低层命令→可行性预测器(infeasible→重规划/feasible→记忆(占位符→用户信息)→执行器)→执行结果→完整性验证器→(完成否→协调器);‘Vision Inputs’到协调器的虚线仅在重规划路径
读图:LLM 范式的可行性提示=系统提示+1 个示例(‘Click the details icon of financial news’→No);输入是屏幕元素文本描述列表(ID/Content/Location),无像素;1-shot
读图:LLM 范式的完整性提示=系统提示+1 个示例(Open the sports news→‘有相关内容元素→Yes’);输入仅执行后元素描述,判据近似‘出现相关元素’
读图:DSM 可行性预测器=视觉编码器(截图)+语言解码器(命令)→<s_feasibility>0/1</s_feasibility>;直接看像素
读图:任务 9 前 5 步:协调器 ‘click sort by price’→可行性预测器 No(页面无此元素)→重规划时协调器获得元素 ID 列表并改点 ‘Sort by: Featured’→完整性验证器 No(还需一步)。证实重规划时才提供元素信息
读图:任务 9 第 1–6 步完整流程;步 6 重规划得到 ‘price: low to high’
读图:任务 9 第 7 步起:‘cheapest charger’ 不可行→协调器以‘最小 y 坐标’代替选择;‘add to chart’ 不可行→点 See All Buying Options→完整性 No→再规划 ‘add to chart’。最后一步仍出现协调器重复拼写错误的动作,展示重规划依赖协调器
读图:任务 12 失败:预测器正确判 ‘Download ZIP’ 不可行,但协调器重规划重复同一动作,预测器再次 No;图中给出人类真值两步(Local→Download ZIP),系统无法自行产出

signatures.object: 协调器 LLM 与执行器之间的执行前门控(基线=命令直接送执行器)
signatures.information: 当前截图 + 低层命令(DSM 看像素;LLM 范式看屏幕解析器输出的元素文本);协调器只在重规划时获得元素 ID/内容/位置
signatures.operation: 分类 feasible(0/1);infeasible → 协调器重规划;feasible → 执行
signatures.conditions: 命令与当前屏幕元素匹配;重规划上限(数值未报告);上限到即终止并反馈用户
signatures.feedback: 预测器输出+重规划时的屏幕元素列表
signatures.selection_rule_data: 训练数据=40K Common Crawl 页面生成 1.1M 图文对,合成命令为正例,伪造标题命令为负例
signatures.claimed_effect: 减少无效执行并提高成功率(12 任务:+5)
signatures.failure_boundary: 协调器无法给出正确重规划(任务 12);合成负例与真实不可行命令分布不同

signatures.object: 执行后验证(基线=无反馈的开环执行)
signatures.information: 已执行命令+执行后截图(DSM)/执行后元素文本(LLM);无执行前状态
signatures.operation: 分类 complete(0/1);否 → 协调器重规划
signatures.conditions: 命令目标可从执行后单帧判断
signatures.selection_rule_data: 训练=页面转移三元组[截图A,元素标题,截图B]为正例,假项替换为负例
signatures.failure_boundary: 一次性单帧判断;prompt 示例判据为‘出现相关元素’,易漏判不可逆错误

signatures.object: 用户敏感信息流(基线=敏感信息进入云端 LLM)
signatures.information: NER 检测用户指令中的敏感字段;占位符+本地字典记忆;命令回传到边缘执行器时再还原
signatures.conditions: 敏感信息可被 NER 检出;屏幕元素信息仅在重规划时上传
signatures.claimed_effect: 2 个案例中不影响成功率
signatures.failure_boundary: 未测 NER 召回/泄露;重规划时屏幕信息仍上传云端

retention_trace.reason: ResponsibleTA 是执行期门控/验证框架+训练的验证器;不声称自我改进或跨任务留存。验证器权重为离线训练,运行期无选择留存。

gap.author_gap: LLM 协调器与领域执行器协作时:协调器对执行器能力了解不足、可能发出不合理命令、无法获知执行完成度,且用户隐私暴露;现有工作只用手写摘要式描述提示
gap.checked_gap: ‘命令不可行/执行未完成’的现象在案例中成立(Fig.4/6/7/8);‘现有提示描述不足’是断言,本文没有对比先前方法,仅比较自家两种范式;最近邻(SayCan 类外部 critic、反思/执行结果跟踪[35,37])原文不在固定集合

claims.setting: 12 个自选真实任务;GPT-4 协调器;自训练执行器(mIoU 0.51);人类专家步数作参考
claims.baseline_control: Baseline(协调器+执行器,无模块)、+Fea.、+Fea.+Com.;安全保护在所有配置开启
claims.selection_vs_test: 无划分;任务由作者选择

claims.text: 领域专用模型(DSM)作为可行性预测/完整性验证优于提示 LLM

claims.result_denominator: 可行性 Acc 74.8 vs 68.9(GPT-4);完整性 83.8 vs 62.9
claims.allowed_conclusion: scoped:在合成构造的二分类集合上,训练的像素+命令模型优于 1-shot 文本元素提示的 LLM;LLM 只看解析器文本且仅 1 个示例,信息与训练量不对等,不能推出‘领域模型优于优化过的提示范式’。
